name: Brightwave
tagline: AI agents that build analyst-grade financial research from filings, calls, and your dataroom.
description: Brightwave is an enterprise AI research platform for finance that deploys agents to synthesize filings, earnings-call transcripts, sell-side reports, news, expert calls, and internal documents into citation-backed deliverables. Rather than answering one-off questions, it produces 'living documents' that update as new information lands. It targets hedge funds, asset managers, and deal teams, and integrates into Microsoft Office and the browser.
insight: Raised a $15M Series A in 2024 led by Decibel Partners (total funding ~$21M); early clients managed over $120B in assets.
edge: Goes beyond Q&A chat to assemble living, analyst-grade research memos across filings, transcripts, and your own dataroom — every claim cited.
pros: Living research docs, not one-off answers

references.title: AI-Powered Financial Research Assistant Brightwave Raises $6M In Seed Funding
